summary: Part 2 (06:38-12:12) of the "6.0 Returns (Seller)" video shows, on the Revibe admin dashboard, how a seller records an invalid claim with supplier proof, how the trainer demonstrates the Revibe-side confirmation (Valid or Invalid with a comment), how a claim returns to the seller at stage 'Under revision' when the proof is judged insufficient, how the seller replaces the proof and sets Invalid again so the claim goes to Revibe Lab, and ends with a recap of the Revibe Return Process PDF. All 40 frames listed in the pack were opened and checked against the narration.

unclear.issue: Narration says 'The invalid button is not available anymore', but the Mark invalid button still appears in the toolbar in frames t00404 and t00437. The frames do not clearly show a disabled state, so it is not stated as a fact.
The Revibe confirmation comments field shows only a text-cursor mark in t00456; the typed text, if any, is not legible. The narration only says 'also to put a comment.'
Narration says a new proof was provided, but no new file name or attachment change is visible in frames t00573 to t00585. The file picker frame (t00569) does not show which file was chosen.

The narration says the outcome will be mentioned in the LAB decision field (the word before 'will mention' is unclear, marked {who?}). The video does not say whether the seller or Revibe Lab sets this field, although the trainer sets it in the demo (t00627).

At Lab Valid, narration says 'you will get back your device and get refunded' (10:15), and at 12:06 'full refund to the customer'. The PDF says 'Valid -> full refund + ship back to seller'. Who receives the refund at Lab Valid is not settled by the evidence.

Narration says 'if you refuse to pay', but the PDF says the customer does not pay and the device is kept (frame t00674). The speech wording differs from the PDF, so the fact is stated from the PDF, not from the narration.
'{five?} working days to close a claim' is a low-confidence number, and it conflicts with the six working days in the next line. No screen or other speech confirms it. Not stated as a fact.

The video does not say whether sellers can edit the Revibe confirmation and LAB decision fields, or whether the trainer is demonstrating the Revibe agent view inside the seller dashboard. Frames show the same claim panel with these fields editable.
The upload shows 'Format not supported' (frame t00402), yet a PNG file is listed under Supplier's Proof of Invalidity later (frame t00414). The accepted file formats are not stated in the video.

The 'Are you sure?' dialog appears after LAB decision is set to Valid claim (frames t00627, t00634), but the click that triggers it is not shown. It is unclear whether the same dialog appears for a seller's own Valid decision.
